name: Bruce Laird
profileSummary: Bruce Malcolm Laird is a former Western Australian and Australian cricketer. He was an opening batsmen who played in 21 Test matches and 23 One Day Internationals. He also played 13 "Supertests" in World Series Cricket organised by Kerry Packer. He was a part of the Australian squad which finished as runners-up at the 1975 Cricket World Cup.
